p_1d5f38faec.sentence: The Department for Transport says you could face a fine of up to £1,000 if found guilty of breaking a rule.
p_1d5f38faec.prev: And it may not end with just a request.
p_1d5f38faec.next: One example is making noise that bothers others.

p_bb6e5d31c4.sentence: But one song played for fun could end up costing a lot.
p_bb6e5d31c4.prev: This does not mean you will get a £1,000 fine as soon as you make a sound.
p_bb6e5d31c4.next: The government also said in October 2026 that passengers may have to get off at the next station.

p_7f4e25052a.sentence: Do not make the person beside you tell you off.

p_210c04c598.sentence: Keep your music to yourself, so other passengers do not have to ask you to stop.
p_210c04c598.prev: Britain’s railways ask people to use headphones, and rules ban sounds that bother others without the railway’s written permission.

p_782cb23f18.sentence: Suddenly, you have to hear a “solo concert” from the person next to you.
p_782cb23f18.prev: You have just got on a train.
p_782cb23f18.next: You do not remember buying a ticket.

p_321d2aeba4.sentence: In other words, if you do not stop the sound, your trip could end before it is over.
p_321d2aeba4.prev: They can use only the force they need.
p_321d2aeba4.next: But the main point of this story is not just the fine.

p_4581fc009c.sentence: Because of this clash of sounds, Britain’s railways have started a campaign.
p_4581fc009c.prev: And we cannot choose the song.
p_4581fc009c.next: They are asking people to use headphones.

p_106f0aba1b.sentence: If they refuse, staff can make them leave.
p_106f0aba1b.prev: If staff have a good reason to think someone has broken a rule, staff who are allowed to act can ask that person to leave.
p_106f0aba1b.next: They can use only the force they need.

p_6d244f5836.sentence: This is allowed only if the railway company has given written permission.
p_6d244f5836.prev: In the UK, railway rules ban singing or playing sounds from a device in a way that bothers other people.
p_6d244f5836.next: The problem is not “forgetting your headphones.”

p_c0e57121e3.sentence: They also stop you from making everyone around you an audience without their agreement.
p_c0e57121e3.prev: Headphones let you enjoy the sounds you like.
p_c0e57121e3.next: We all share the train car and the time it takes to reach our destination.
